description: This file defines an interface for configuration settings related to an exponential back-off strategy, including properties such as minimum and maximum durations, a random factor, and a timeout for corrupted supervisor states. It also includes an enumeration of default configuration values and their associated config paths.

classes.name: ExponentialBackOffConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration methods for exponential back-off behavior.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimal exponential back-off duration.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximal exponential back-off duration.

methods.name: getRandomFactor
methods.description: Returns the random factor of the exponential back-off strategy.

methods.name: getCorruptedReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum idle time before a corrupted supervisor terminates.

classes.name: ExponentialBackOffConfig.ExponentialBackOffConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for {@code ExponentialBackOffConfig}.
